name: uk.co.aplacetorest/natural-burial-grounds
title: A Place to Rest
description: Find UK natural burial grounds for ashes, pet ashes or a green burial, with their published prices.

tools.name: find_burial_grounds
tools.description: Finds UK natural and green burial grounds near a postcode, town or county, nearest first, with what each allows (ashes, pet ashes, full burial, memorial trees) and its published ashes burial price. Optional filters narrow the results.

location.description: A UK postcode (NN1 1AA), postcode district (NN1), town or city (Northampton, or Ashford, Kent), or county.

radius_miles.description: How far to search. Default 25 miles.

accepts_ashes.description: Only places that say they accept ashes.

accepts_pet_ashes.description: Only places that say they accept pet ashes.

full_body_burial.description: Only places that offer full (coffin or shroud) green burials.

memorial_trees.description: Only places that offer memorial trees.

max_ashes_price_gbp.description: Only places whose published ashes burial price is at or below this, in pounds.

tools.name: get_burial_ground
tools.description: Returns everything listed for one natural burial ground: address, website, what it allows for ashes and burials, memorials, published prices with their source, and the pages its facts were checked against.

burial_ground.description: The slug from find_burial_grounds, or the burial ground's name.

tools.name: ashes_burial_prices
tools.description: Summarises the ashes burial prices UK natural burial grounds publish (lowest, median, highest), for the whole UK or one county, region or country, and lists the priced places cheapest first with what each price includes.

area.description: A county (Northamptonshire), region (South West) or country (Wales). Leave out for the whole UK.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches A Place to Rest's UK guides on burying and scattering ashes, green burial, costs, rules, pet ashes and memorials. Returns the best-matching guide's full text with its URL, and other relevant guides. Leave out the question to list every guide.

question.description: What the person wants to know, such as "can I bury ashes in my garden".
